title: Импорт — База данных
semantics: Read one table/view or one read-only SELECT through a module SQLite connection to a .db file in the user's storage into output table 0: field order, names, observed types, NULL. The node never writes to the database; non-SELECT SQL is refused before any gesture. Connection is created or reused by exact file path; source and query are read back from the wizard. No training. Filters, parameters, macros, ignore-errors, timeout and other DBMS are outside this slice.

parameter_schema.description: New import requires connection and table or sql. Existing {} keeps saved settings.

connection.description: SQLite connection of the current module, matched by exact database file path.

database_path.description: Absolute storage path of the .db file, e.g. /folder/people.db.

mode.description: table: whole table or view; sql: one read-only SELECT.

table.description: mode=table: exact table or view name from the wizard list.

fields.description: mode=table: fields to extract in output order; omit for all fields in source order.

sql.description: mode=sql: one SELECT; ORDER BY fixes row order.
